# Pull Request Description

Provide a brief summary of the changes introduced by this Pull Request.

---

## 1. Type of Changes
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] DevOps/IaC/Technical documentation update

---

## 2. Validation & Testing Checklist
Please verify that your branch satisfies the following tests before requesting review:
- [ ] I have executed backend tests with `pytest` and they pass cleanly.
- [ ] I have formatted my code using Black and sorted imports using Isort.
- [ ] I have verified that no secrets or private credentials are included in my changes.
- [ ] I have updated the technical manuals if adding new endpoints or SRE checks.
